description:
The image features a collection of small, intricately designed items arranged on a fabric background. The items include a pair of black scissors with white polka dots, a beaded necklace or keychain, and two small pouches adorned with various decorative elements.

The pouches are crafted from a light-colored fabric and have a distinctive shape, resembling a shield or a badge. Each pouch is secured with a ribbon and features an assortment of small objects, including a metal charm with the letters "DMC"
